reason: I would download it and join the free stuff for sure, the yoga and the hikes are exactly what I want instead of clubs. But buy a ticket? 700 Lek is my coffee money for a week, so the paid part of this app is not for me.
objection: I pay cash for everything, and I do not trust putting my card in a new app to buy a ticket I could probably get cheaper at the door or through a friend.
would_change_my_mind: Student or last-minute discounted tickets, say 300-400 Lek, or a way to reserve in the app and pay cash at the entrance.
